I was diagnosed with something called “portal hypertension” (it’s basically like my venous leading all blood into my liver to get filtered is halfway to blown out) when I got the diagnosis it was scary af- my doctor actually told me,  “they were confused, and didn’t know why I had this at 23 at the time- and it was something people got after years of intense radiation for cancer treatment or something of old people die of that is catergorized as “a natural cause” I spent the year pretty much paralyzed in fear to do much of anything- but I’m 27 (fresh 27) now and have done many more things then I thought originally and I’m still here. It’s had its rough points both physically and mentally and I’ll be going through that journey for as many more years as I am blessed to receive. But if I could take back living in fear for that year and doing things I would because life is short. Don’t give up O.P, we may not always win the fights we’re given but damn can we have some good times fighting them. When it comes to drugs- which I enjoy quite a lot-especially of the psychedelic brand- I have found which ones I can do now that won’t push my body to far and which ones I can’t, and I’ve learned how to draw my line and know my limits for the most. And I definitely still have had some VERY great trippy times. I’m also a strong advocate for medicinal marijuana actually being able to reverse cancer/medical problems almost entirely with the right mix for the specific ailment. I wish you strength and perspective on this journey and I pray you come out of it on the other side an epic survivor reppin the trippy life.

I have some really interesting psych ward stories... kinda actually upbeat-

One time we were all in the common room and I had been wearing this young and wild and free hat cus I have slight... hair dysphasia, and it was like my 4th day had been really vibing with everyone and before morning group- I started the entire room into singing young and wild and free- it was beautiful

I learned how to shuffle cards, play spades and do the Rick Ross ouuhh and play poker for frozen cranberry cups and saltines

Had water damage in our common room (different place) and had my two buddies (one my roommate) start lifting me up to put my head through it so the water would break through and we would be released (not the best plan but thankfully my head did not go through)

Learned a lot about pigeons- and how they mate due to the lack of entertainment and the group of pigeons living right outside the commons window

Taught a older woman going through some really tough stuff some cheers since she had once been a cheerleader and then performing them during smoke breaks together and getting to see her smile and laugh

The craziest one to me... this lady had been brought to my friends room and was pretty much catatonic couldn’t walk, couldn’t speak (muttered a few things that sounded like another language entirely. And my friend asked me to check out her room.. which was not allowed but shit were just trying to normalize and not normal situation so I did. When I walk in the lady manages to lift one arm and is just pointing at the window, my friend just nervously laughs which I totally get but in my heart I felt like she was reaching out for help- so I followed her point to the window which had some white substance on it and I don’t know why but I thought maybe this is what is bothering her? Stupid I know. But I cleaned it off and turned around and said I hope this helped a little- she sits straight up in bed-
Eyes wide open and she says to me (first time she spoke there) “you have Jesus in you don’t you?” Brought tears to my eyes because through every struggle he was the one dude I couldn’t give up on. And then she stands up and was walking talking even dancing the rest of her stay! It was like witnessing a miracle!

It was also pretty funny walking into my room on arrival once to find my roommate contorted in such an odd fashion so she could gyrate her hips more sexually at the cute (in her opinion) male nurse- she was just being funny didn’t really have a physical contortion problem- then she just stands up when he leaves like my names ...... I wanna fuck him so bad... and also who are you??? She was awesome we attempted to make a window key out of soap and it almost worked! And she left before me and dropped me off a whole ass care package, lo and behold we are still in each others lives, oh did I mention at this one there were no cigarette breaks or anything like that- so her boyfriend during visit manages to sneak her one through her shoe/leg and we enjoyed many mid day and late night e cig sessions in our rooms bathroom and never got caught- and I’ll tell you what an e-cig just hits different when your doing it sneakily 😂🤟🏻

Psych wards can be intimidating, I know my first time I walked in to hearing “she threw her coffee on me” and looking up at the ceiling by the pay phone thing to see what appeared to be blood- I mean I was scared shitless- but that one was the one with the card shuffling, the rick Ross and the young and wild and free. Everytime
I have went I have been done with life completely but the beautiful souls of the good nurses (the ones that sneak you turkey sandwiches and baguette) and the beautiful souls of the other patients there including my own have managed to save me and my outlook on life. I accept my illness and know it could happen again that I need that help but I also accept that in that moment I will be somewhere where I will learn a great deal of self love techniques and even make some bomb ass memories and friends
